newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open steady to firm.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open steady to firm.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were expected to open steady to firm Friday in line with LME copper as the market consolidated following the slide earlier this week.
COMEX September copper was called unchanged to up 0.30 cent from Thursday's close of 104.35 cents a lb after trading from 103.15 to 104.40 cents on ACCESS.
LME copper stocks rose a further 2,800 tonnes to 139,125 tonnes in Friday's data, while COMEX copper stocks fell a further 1,574 short tons Thursday to 36,449 short tons.
In industry news, activity at the Neves Corvo copper mine in southern Portugal remained suspended due to a strike.
But the seasonal summer demand slowdown meant the market was ignoring any supply problems, traders said.
